subject.title: fix: render workspace avatars in identity card

question: After the SDK leak is repaired, should this PR be the canonical fix for the Personal-card workspace avatar 401 cluster and should the stricter image-only local avatar policy apply across identity/list/bootstrap surfaces?
rationale: Automation can keep the new helpers internal, but selecting the canonical overlapping PR and accepting the compatibility behavior for existing avatar values requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Repair and use this PR
options.body: Keep the owner-level projection, remove the public SDK expansion, and land this branch as the canonical fix if the stricter local-avatar policy is acceptable.

options.title: Preserve older list behavior
options.body: Require the branch to preserve previous `agents.list` compatibility while changing only identity/bootstrap paths that produced protected routes.

options.title: Defer to a narrower PR
options.body: Pause this branch if maintainers prefer one of the smaller overlapping avatar PRs as the landing vehicle for the linked issue.

recommendation.title: Repair and use this PR
recommendation.body: Keep the owner-level projection, remove the public SDK expansion, and land this branch as the canonical fix if the stricter local-avatar policy is acceptable.
